steps.caption: Newest first: each applied change, its fields and where it came from.
Tags show how it arrived — e.g. 'AI extracted' — and that it was applied.
To undo several, tick them and press Undo selected. Later edits are kept and reported.
Here: undo the budget / move-in change from the notes. Press Undo on its card and confirm.
The record is back to what it was, and the undo itself is logged.
Undo can't unsend messages or reverse promises made outside CRE OS.
